ios.desc:
Play against computer opponent or meet random players from around the world.

The game features include:
- Game of Cross where minimum of 5 pieces are required to win
- Game of Side where minimum of 9 pieces are required to win
- Background music and SFX
- No account or login required to play the game.
- Leaderboard is available if you create the optional ID
- No personal data is collected.
- Easy on the device battery and your internet connection.

Qube is supported by unobstructive banner advertising.
To disable the ads, simply beat the Game of Side in single player mode once.

quotes.title: I made a game with ads you can remove by beating the hard mode once
quotes.story_title: I made a game with ads you can remove by beating the hard mode once
